opening.argument: The opportunity is presented as profit-making participation in OneCoin, with the narration explaining "how to make a profit from the cryptocurrency" and positioning viewers in "an unlimited revenue generating program." Recruitment is central to that opportunity: viewers are promised support to "grow your team and business," while the description directs them to "join the largest team build." These statements connect the anticipated earning opportunity to expanding a team and business, rather than offering neutral cryptocurrency education.
